description: u-maker hooks. PreToolUse: on-edit-guard.js is the STRICT side-effect gatekeeper — it asks for explicit user approval before EXISTING code in a u-maker project is modified (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Bash), so dev/bug-fix changes cannot introduce silent side-effects (wired directly, NOT through _dispatch.js, which never blocks). PostToolUse: reactive hooks keep dropzone index, doc<->JSON sync, gate loop state, and deploy staleness in sync after file mutations, dispatched through _dispatch.js.
